text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on November 25 and 26, 2020. November 25, 2020 Speaker Nunziata, during the morning session of the meeting, welcomed back Councillor Jaye Robinson. Councillor Jaye Robinson addressed City Council and expressed how great and how fortunate it is to be back after her battle with cancer. Councillor Robinson spoke of the number of women that will be diagnosed with breast cancer and wanted these women to know that they are not alone. Councillor Robinson thanked the health care workers for treating patients during the pandemic. Councillor Robinson also thanked Members of Council, City staff and her team for their support.
